meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: ALWAYS proposes the final materials first (PDF+DOCX default), then parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos — max-roster teammode when the harness has it — with live journaling, a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text, empirical verification by running code, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind a mandatory visual-QA gate. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多来源深度调研自动整理成带引用的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需针对复杂问题多方位查证并输出有证据的总结
copy.tagline_en: Automatically turn multi-source research into cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need multi-source research and evidence-backed summaries

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求做研究时,Claude 会启动“最大饱和研究”:先给出最终成果样式(PDF+DOCX),再派多组搜索覆盖代码库、网页、官方文档、开源仓库等;实时记日志,顺线索递归深挖,用代码验证,最后交付带引用和图表的综合报告。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求做研究时触发:比如说出“ulw-research”、要求“深度研究”、提到 ultradebate/hyperdebate 研究请求等。普通提问、调试、收集上下文不会激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调查一下 X 的现状和证据
say.note: 会进入最大饱和模式,先给出报告样式再并行搜索。

say.text: 请做一次深度研究,比较 A 方案与 B 方案的优劣
say.note: 会跨源码、网页、文档多路并行查证,产出带引用的报告。

say.text: 对 C 做一次超精确调查,并验证每个结论
say.note: 会用运行代码验证争议点,并给出引用来源。

howto.what_en: Claude runs exhaustive research: proposes deliverable (PDF+DOCX), deploys explorer/librarian swarms over codebase, web, docs, OSS repos; journals live; expands leads; verifies claims by code; delivers cited synthesis with charts post-QA.
howto.when_en: Activates on explicit research: 'ulw-research', 'ulw' wording, 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or 'deep research'/'ultra-precise investigation'. Never for ordinary Q&A, debugging, context-gathering.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate the current state and evidence for X.
say_en.note: Enters max-saturation mode: proposes report format first, then parallel search.

say_en.text: Do a deep research comparing A and B approaches.
say_en.note: Runs multi-source parallel verification and delivers a cited report.

say_en.text: Run an ultra-precise investigation on C, verifying every conclusion.
say_en.note: Executes code checks for contested claims and includes citations.
